root_cause.surface: engine `get_price` logs `获取价格数据失败` and returns an empty frame
root_cause.why: sealed STOCK_TRADEABILITY_PIT_R1 stores `paused` as 0.0/1.0 in some snapshot tips and as bool in others; concatenating them yields object dtype with mixed entries, and pandas refuses the boolean cast (`Need to pass bool-like values`)
root_cause.effect: the 09:20 selection lost its whole price map (funnel l3=0), so the engine reported COMPLETED with 0 trades while strategy logic never ran
root_cause.fix: explicit 0/1/True/False/NA normalisation (`_as_nullable_bool`) applied once to the reconciled tradeability frame and once in get_price; any other value fails loudly instead of degrading to an empty price frame
root_cause.regression_evidence: same 3-session probe after the fix: 0 price-fetch failures and the strategy trades (final capital differs from initial)
captured_pre_fix_frame: pandas/core/arrays/boolean.py:200 coerce_to_array -> TypeError: Need to pass bool-like values
root_cause.captured_pre_fix_calls: 5 events in 3 sessions, 5 unique frames, sample dtype=object values=[0.0, True]

note: the engine logs the message and returns an empty frame, so a data-layer failure silently becomes an empty candidate list
